articles.summary: SID-2 trains search models with RL to be steered to an objective and an effort, and SID-2 Swarm trains them to search in parallel and share discoveries, so coordinated groups of small models outperform larger individual models. This report covers metric steering, reasoning effort, self-play data, the swarm harness and infrastructure.
articles.title: SID-2 Technical Report: Scaling Search Swarms

articles.summary: We estimate that LLMs generated an indexed public web’s worth of output tokens every 15 days in 2026, and about 1.7x as many output tokens this year as humans have written across all digital sources. This paper explains the methodology.
articles.title: AI is writing the equivalent of the public internet every 15 days
